calls.title: Experiment Redesign Kickoff
calls.summary: The team focused on simplifying the variation editing experience by prioritizing single feature flag use cases over complex multi-flag scenarios to speed development and reduce UI confusion. They discussed the ongoing challenges with variation cards and split percentages, considering clearer visualization methods. Additionally, the importance of better UI discoverability for the deletion of variations was highlighted. Implementation and empty state improvements were addressed, aiming to collapse unused sections while clarifying CTAs for feature flags. The philosophy of iterative building was emphasized, prioritizing core flows and clear decision-making. Roles and responsibilities were assigned to avoid bottlenecks, ensuring that components ready for development would be acted upon promptly, while balancing compression and clarity in UI design.
calls.keywords: Experiment redesign, Variation editing, Feature flags, Prelaunch checklist, Implementation table, UI component breakup
